title: Sweden's Election Race Tightens as Inflation Falls and Growth Outlook Improves · 17 Aug
keywords: Sweden election, Swedish inflation, Sweden GDP growth, NIER forecast, Swedish politics, centre-left opposition, governing bloc, Riksbank, cost of living Sweden, European economy
notes: Sweden's governing right-wing bloc is closing the gap with the centre-left opposition ahead of the country's election, even as new economic data show inflation at near-zero levels and growth forecasts are being revised upward. The convergence of political momentum and improving economic conditions has sharpened the campaign debate over who deserves credit for Sweden's recovery. The stakes extend well beyond domestic politics, touching on broader European questions of fiscal discipline, household welfare, and the durability of post-inflation rebounds.
